html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In this patch, you will meet a mafia mercenary who rushes like a ruthless runaway train, 
and a scientist who has broken free from the madness that once consumed him.


Rhino, who gained terrifying durability through 

gamma radiation experiments and bonded with his suit of armor, 

and Green Goblin, known for his unpredictable aerial combat using his glider, 

have received Tier-4 Advancements and New Uniforms!

 

Agents, please download the 8/11 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!

 

 

■ 8/11 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 8/12 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 8/11 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[8/12 (Wed) 3:33 (UTC+0), 8/11 (Tue) 20:33 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 8/12 (Wed) 2:46 (UTC+0), 8/11 (Tue) 19:46 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


Two new Uniforms, Green Goblin <Gold Goblin>, 
and Rhino <Uncanny Spider-Man> have been added.


* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The two new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the ‘<Spider-Man: Brand New Day> 2nd Update Celebration Event’ and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.


* To celebrate the Spider-Man’s Archenemy update, a 10% Agent Supplies discount coupon will be distributed.
- Coupon Acquisition & Validity Period: 
8/11 (Tue) 15:00 - 8/25 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
8/11 (Tue) 8:00 - 8/25 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)

 

 

 

 

▣ Green Goblin & Rhino Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancements have been added for Rhino, who charges straight ahead through brute force rather than strategy, and Green Goblin, reborn in a dazzling gold suit.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 


▣ Game Error Fixes


1. Fixed an issue where certain text did not display correctly in specific languages.
- Corrected mistranslations for some quiz answers
- Corrected mistranslations in recommended skill combo (Auto Open)

 

[8/12 (Wed) 2:48 (UTC+0), 8/11 (Tue) 19:48 (PDT) added]

2. Fixed an issue where the 'Great Team of Heroes for New Agents' product is distributing incorrect quantities of crystals.

- Missing amounts will be sent out as compensation to affected Agents at a later date.

We will update this announcement once the distribution is complete.

[8/12 (Wed) 9:45 (UTC+0), 8/12 (Wed) 2:45 (PDT) added]
As of 8/12 (Wed) 8:50 (UTC+0), 8/12 (Wed) 1:50 (PDT), all rewards have been sent out.
The rewards will be stored in your inbox for 60 days from the time of distribution.
Please make sure to claim them before they expire.

 

[8/12 (Wed) 2:48 (UTC+0), 8/11 (Tue) 19:48 (PDT) added]

3. Fixed an issue where VIP Points are not distributed correctly upon purchasing certain products.
[Affected Products]

- Great Leader for New Agents

- Great Dealer for New Agents

- Great Support for New Agents

- Great Team of Heroes for New Agents

- The remaining difference in VIP Points will be distributed to the affected Agents at a later date.
We will update this notice once the distribution is complete.

[8/12 (Wed) 9:45 (UTC+0), 8/12 (Wed) 2:45 (PDT) added]
As of 8/12 (Wed) 8:50 (UTC+0), 8/12 (Wed) 1:50 (PDT), all VIP Points have been sent out.
The rewards will be stored in your inbox for 60 days from the time of distribution.
Please make sure to claim them before they expire.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
